features.name: Multiple token selection in JSON
features.description: The select token method now allows selecting multiple tokens in a single operation. Users can select a number of origins into a result list and work with arrays and complex JSON objects.

features.name: Add destination table filter method
features.description: A new method on data transfer object that allows filtering what you want to update in a data transfer. Enables targeted updates to specific rows based on conditions.

features.name: Update audit fields in cloud for data transfer
features.description: The update audit fields method is now available in cloud environments. Users can control whether system modified and other audit fields will be updated as part of the data transfer.

features.name: Analysis views in extensions
features.description: Developers can now define and include analysis views in their extensions. Analysis views can be shipped with pages and applications.
features.status_evidence_quote: the ability to define and include analysis views in your extension. You can now ship analysis views with your pages

features.name: Three-tier namespace resolution strategy
features.description: Automated namespace adoption uses a three-tier resolution strategy: namespace template in settings.json, sibling file inference using longest common prefix, or fallback to publisher.projectname. Simplifies adding namespaces to existing codebases.

features.name: Fully qualified names for object resolution
features.description: Extended object metadata model to carry namespace information for name-based object resolution at runtime. Supports running codeunits, pages and reports using fully qualified name string literals. Supports recordref.open with fully qualified table names and exposes fully qualified name property on records.

features.name: Download symbols from global sources
features.description: New command to download symbol packages directly from Microsoft public NuGet feeds without authentication or environment setup. Resolves platform, application and dependency packages including second-level dependencies automatically.
caveats: Only symbols packages available from public feeds

features.name: Custom NuGet feeds for symbols
features.description: Users can specify their own NuGet feeds using AL.NuGetFeeds setting for downloading symbols from custom sources. Custom feeds take priority over Microsoft feeds, and can be configured to completely disable Microsoft feeds using use only custom feeds setting.

features.name: Test execution in AL extension
features.description: Test execution is now built into the AL language extension, allowing users to run tests directly from Visual Studio Code.

features.name: AL workspace create command
features.description: New command to create workspace files automatically by scanning for app.json files in a directory and its subdirectories. Enables efficient multi-project builds.

features.name: Workspace map command
features.description: Command that visualizes workspace contents by creating a markdown file using mermaid diagrams to show project dependencies and structure.

features.name: Workspace compile with parallel builds
features.description: New workspace compile tool that computes the most efficient compilation graph from workspace dependencies and executes parallel compilation. Can compile multiple projects simultaneously based on dependency analysis.

features.name: Simple only detection command
features.description: Command to determine whether an app.json file is a simple only app or contains full application content. Used in AL Go for GitHub pipelines.

features.name: Runtime specification in directory app.props.json
features.description: New capability to specify runtime version in the directory app.props.json file, which gets added to the manifest. Allows centralized runtime configuration for multi-project workspaces.

features.name: Parallel workspace compilation
features.description: Workspace compile now supports parallel processing with configurable process counts, reducing compilation time from 50 minutes with one process to 26 minutes with four processes on GitHub runners, achieving 75% reduction.
caveats: Comparison shows differences between workspace compile and AL Go due to orchestration differences with BC container helper

features.name: AL Go hardware utilization
features.description: AL Go users will get parallel compilation benefits for free when using AL Go for GitHub, improving pipeline performance without additional configuration.
caveats: Feature available to existing AL Go users automatically

features.name: AI-assisted code generation with AL constraints
features.description: AI developers treat generated code as a draft to be reviewed and refined, using AL as a constraint layer to ensure correctness, security, and maintainability while generating code through agents.

features.name: Iterative prototyping with AI
features.description: Developers can build prototypes within a day rather than a week using AI assistance, enabling rapid hypothesis testing, learning, and iterative refinement with proper architecture and testing.

features.name: AI agent feedback loop with success criteria
features.description: Agents can iterate on solutions and recover from failures automatically when given a task definition and success criteria such as passing AL tests, enabling autonomous achievement of development goals.

features.name: AL tools for GitHub Copilot in VS Code
features.description: New AL-specific tools integrated into GitHub Copilot in Visual Studio Code allowing agents to build, debug, fix diagnostics and solve complex problems using AL language capabilities.
caveats: Requires VS Code and GitHub Copilot

features.name: Automatic diagnostic fixing with Copilot
features.description: GitHub Copilot agent can identify and fix AL diagnostics automatically, including refactoring code for obsoleted dependency symbols and rebuilding the project.

features.name: AL MCP server for non-VS Code agents
features.description: New AL Model Context Protocol server enabling agents like Claude and Codex to work with AL code outside VS Code, with AL-specific tools supporting compilation, diagnostics, and fixing scenarios.
caveats: Currently in pre-release; will move to standard release version
Tools not identical to VS Code version but support most scenarios

features.name: Automated agentic pipelines with AL MCP
features.description: AL MCP enables completely automated agentic pipelines for extension maintenance, including compilation, diagnostic checking, fixing, test creation, and pull request generation without human intervention.
caveats: Requires AL MCP server and agent configuration

features.name: Business Central troubleshooting MCP server
features.description: New MCP server that exposes the debug runtime to GitHub Copilot, allowing AI to analyze execution context, stack frames, and variables during debugging sessions.

features.name: Copilot-assisted error debugging
features.description: Copilot can analyze code execution at a breakpoint, inspect stack frames and variables, identify root causes of errors, and suggest fixes.

features.name: Copilot performance profiling without profiler
features.description: Copilot can analyze performance problems using the troubleshooting MCP server without requiring a dedicated performance profiling session, identifying issues like CalcFields in loops.
caveats: Requires code to be at breakpoint

features.name: Stack frame inspection via Copilot
features.description: Copilot can fetch and inspect specific stack frames, retrieve variables across all stack frames or given frames, and access relevant AL source code for a frame.

features.name: Copilot-driven breakpoint control
features.description: Copilot can add breakpoints by object name or ID and type plus line number, enabling guided debugging sessions without manual UI interaction.
